# Rosalind Franklin — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What field did Rosalind Franklin work in?", "chemistry"),
    ("What is Rosalind Franklin known for?", "X-ray crystallography of DNA"),
    ("What is lived?", "1920-1958"),
    ("What is field?", "chemistry"),

    ("What is note?", "Photo 51 was key to the double helix"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
